title: Fix stale start status in e-document import pipeline
summary: The e-document import pipeline now uses the initial processing status instead of the post-undo status for telemetry emission and event triggering, fixing an edge case where no telemetry or event was sent after undoing to unprocessed.
key_points: Changed telemetry emit guard to use initial status before undo operations
Modified OnAfterProcessIncomingEDocument event to use initial status instead of current status
Fixes edge case where undoing to unprocessed state prevented telemetry and events from being emitted
Improves code quality by maintaining consistent status usage
quote: Use the initial (pre-undo) processing status instead of the post-undo CurrentStatus for both the telemetry emit guard and the OnAfterProcessIncomingEDocument event.
